---
title: Update a feed cell
description: Move your feed cell forward to a newer signed price.
---

```ts
const update = await oracle.pullAndUpdate(typeScript);
const fee = await oracle.completeFee(update.tx, signer);
if (fee.status === "ok") await signer.sendTransaction(fee.tx);

console.log(update.before.price, "→", update.after.price);
```

`pullAndUpdate` fetches the latest update from the mirror, verifies it against the live committee
cell, and builds the transaction. It never builds a transaction the chain would reject.

## What the transaction contains

<TxAnatomy />

## Updating in the same transaction that uses the price

Usually you want the price and its use in one transaction, so nothing can happen in between: take
`update.tx`, add your own inputs, outputs and cell deps, then complete the fee. Your contract reads
the **output** feed cell in that case, not a cell dep.

## If you already have an update

Use `oracle.updateFeedCell(typeScript, blob)` with a blob from the Mirror API or your own mirror.

## Common failures

- **Not newer.** Another transaction already moved the cell to this or a later tick. Fetch again.
- **Cell already spent.** The cell changed since you built the transaction. Rebuild it.
- **Insufficient capacity.** `completeFee` returns the shortfall in shannons.
